decision: Normalize loopback URL and Host handling for the Next approval adapter.
rationale: Next supplies an internal localhost request URL while the browser uses 127.0.0.1; validate both as loopback with equal ports and bind Origin to the external Host.

discovery.observation: Actual browser approval returned 403 although isolated endpoint tests passed.
discovery.cause: Framework request normalization was absent from the initial test fixture.
discovery.regression: Independent local-ui.break test now exercises normalized URL, external Host and mismatched port.
